## About
California Auto Glass is a family-run shop on Industrial St in San Francisco. We replace windshields, door glass and sunroofs, and we repair window motors and regulators for cars, trucks and fleet vehicles.
In this city a broken window is something a lot of drivers deal with. When it happens, call us, bring the car in, and we'll talk you through what's wrong and what we're doing about it. Customers have rated us 4.6 from 266 Google reviews.

## Services
- Windshield replacement: A cracked or chipped windshield is a safety problem. Our team replaces it so you can drive with a clear, solid view again.
- Door glass replacement: Broken door glass lets in water and leaves your car open to break-ins. We replace it and make your car whole again.
- Window regulator and motor repair: If your power window won't roll down, we repair the motor or regulator so it works again.
- Sunroof repair and replacement: We refit sunroof glass for a tight seal, check the drainage channels for clogs, and replace sunroof glass when needed.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Saturday, 8 am to 6 pm. Sunday, 8 am to 5:30 pm.

Q: How do I schedule a repair?
A: Give us a call at 415-826-2574 to set up an appointment. You can also email californiaautoglass@hotmail.com.

Q: My sunroof leaks when it rains. Can you help?
A: Yes. Leaks often come from a poor seal or clogged drainage channels. We refit the glass and check the drains for clogs before the water causes stains or moldy smells.
